finish.summary: Built a 3-cell tool caddy: central covered cell carrying a top handle (handle:0,0,0;top), flanked by a full-depth 2-compartment bin and a full-depth 3-compartment bin (5 divided compartments total) dressed with M3 screw, nut and standoff heaps. Open faces capped and joints bolted (capOpenFaces + lockJoints). check_build ok, meshClash clear, no prop warnings (hardware heaps sit below bin rims as loose fasteners should).

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
